77927.subject: Klarna’s Q2 2026: the 42% growth that’s really 20%, a hidden $2B Google win & why KLAR stock crashed 23% anyway 💳…
77927.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1117

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Monday! Today, we’re diving deep into Klarna's latest financials to see how the strongest merchant-distribution machine in BNPL just beat on every headline number and still crashed 23%, & why its 42% margin growth was really 20% with a $69M assist from a line item that didn't exist a year ago (breaking down the most important facts & figures from Klarna's Q2 2026, including the $2B Google judgment buried in a footnote & the guidance raise that's actually flat on the old accounting basis, to see whether $KLAR  is still worth your time & money + bonus deep dive into the latest financials of Nubank [ https://substack.com/redirect/c44016fb-5d4d-4689-85f5-51d5b39d8041?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & The Complete Guide to YC’s Open-Source AI Agent Harness inside [ https://substack.com/redirect/59c1a76b-7fd3-4c7c-938a-f375760e9b8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and how Anthropic built the smartest AI model on the planet and then watched its own customers buy the cheaper one instead (Fable 5's [ https://substack.com/redirect/a0c48c05-fed4-48c9-ba1c-e1cf90bea5a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] spending plateau, why Opus 5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/6a1b76fb-70ab-42e8-92ad-8419acaa0abd?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] is already outselling it, & what this means for app-layer builders and fintechs + The Ultimate Guide to Qwen3.8-27B [ https://substack.com/redirect/790ab563-b5eb-411f-a41f-d80d31117928?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & The Age of the One-Person Company [ https://substack.com/redirect/3295d6da-1a34-4ba8-82d6-43ebe1dd7dea?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the interesting stuff 🌶️
Klarna’s Q2 2026: the 42% growth that’s really 20%, a hidden $2B Google win & why KLAR stock crashed 23% anyway 💳📉
Earnings time 🤑 BNPL giant Klarna $KLAR   just reported the beat everyone wanted - revenue up 27% to $1.04B vs $996M expected, EPS of $0.01 against a forecast $(0.06) loss, transaction margin dollars up 42%, adjusted operating income more than tripled to $91M, net income positive - and the stock crashed 22.81% by the close, then another 4.8% by Friday. Not nice 🥲
At $14.33, KLAR now sits 74.9% below its 52-week high of $57.20 and more than 66% under its $40.00 September 2025 IPO price 🤷‍♂️
The crash itself is no mystery though: Klarna cut its full-year outlook - GMV down to $149-151B from “>$155B”, revenue to $4.08-4.16B from “>$4.34B” against a $4.415B consensus - and Germany, its biggest market, is soft. That’s the story every headline ran with. But it’s not the interesting one.

77923.subject: Kenya Puts 15 Million-Plus Academic Credentials Onchain with Avalanche
77923.body:

More than 15 million academic records are now live on Avalanche’s C-Chain. The Kenya National Examinations Council projects the total will reach roughly 35 million as that rollout continues. KNEC and Avalanche announced the deployment [ https://substack.com/redirect/e5d8bdfd-514e-44df-a5ad-31f597d20b76?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] on Monday, and it’s already one of the largest government-backed deployments on the network to date.
The headline numbers:
15 million-plus records already integrated onto the C-Chain, the figure KNEC and Avalanche confirm as currently live
35 million records projected as the rollout continues
Records dating back to 1989, covering KCPE, KCSE, diploma, and teaching certification data
Close to 1 million KCSE 2025 certificates already distributed exclusively through the new e-certification system

The problem this solves
Kenya has struggled with certificate fraud for years. Thousands of forged academic documents surface annually, ranging from fabricated diplomas to altered exam results, and the damage runs deep. Employers hire unqualified staff, universities admit students on fake transcripts, and legitimate graduates end up competing against paper that was never real. Verifying a certificate the old way meant a slow, manual back-and-forth with KNEC, often taking weeks. None of that scaled to a system managing exam records for a country of more than 50 million people.
What KNEC built
The system converts each historical and current examination record into a blockchain-secured asset on Avalanche’s C-Chain, built in partnership with local technology provider LegitDoc [ https://substack.com/redirect/45365b53-98f2-481e-a4e5-538240c4c09a?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. That creates a registry institutions can query instantly, replacing manual confirmation from examination authorities. Every certificate becomes independently verifiable, so an employer or university can confirm it against the onchain record directly, without needing to trust whoever is holding the physical copy.
What this unlocks:
Employers, universities, and government agencies can verify a certificate’s authenticity directly through the verification portal [ https://substack.com/redirect/ce193703-1b72-4262-96c1-e7d449d685ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], without contacting KNEC
No paperwork trail for fraudsters to exploit, since the source record lives onchain, not in a filing cabinet
Every newly issued certificate now follows the same onchain path, starting with the 2025 KCSE cohort
Verification that used to take weeks now happens in seconds through the verification portal
